question.text: Can the promoter or persons acting in concert (PAC) bid in a delisting offer under SEBI Delisting Regulations, 2021?

answer.text: Yes, they can bid at or above the floor price
Yes, but only up to their existing shareholding percentage
No, the promoter and PAC are prohibited from bidding in the offer
Yes, but only through a separate window designated by the stock exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.226 of the workbook, a promoter or person acting in concert with the promoter shall not make a bid in the delisting offer. The merchant banker is required to ensure compliance with this restriction. The Trap: The other options suggest conditional bidding routes (floor price, existing shareholding cap, separate window), but none are permitted — the prohibition on promoter/PAC bidding is absolute under the SEBI Delisting Regulations, 2021. Note: The merchant banker's role is to ensure the promoter and PACs do not bid, as part of due diligence obligations under the delisting framework.
